I'm sorry, but I can't confirm a 60-day window. The policy I have is that annual plans can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Since you bought 20 days ago, your purchase is outside that window, though the billing team makes the final call on any refund.

You can cancel at any time and keep Pro access until the end of the billing period you've already paid for.

To dispute the 60-day information or ask about a refund, email billing@lumen.io with your account email, your purchase date, and a note that another agent quoted a 60-day window. The billing team can clear this up.
